## Return Policy
Northwind Outfitters accepts returns within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided the item is unused and in its original packaging. Worn or washed items cannot be returned unless defective.
To start a return, use the return portal on our website with your order number. We provide a prepaid shipping label for domestic returns. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of us receiving the item.
Sale items marked final sale cannot be returned or exchanged. Gift cards are non-refundable.

## Shipping Information
Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days and is free on orders over $75. Expedited shipping (2-3 business days) is available for a flat $15 fee. We do not currently ship internationally outside the US and Canada.
Orders placed before 1pm PT ship the same business day. You'll receive a tracking number by email once your order ships.
Canadian orders may be subject to customs fees collected by the carrier on delivery; Northwind Outfitters does not cover these fees.

## Warranty Overview
Most Northwind Outfitters hardgoods (tents, packs, sleeping bags) carry a warranty against manufacturing defects. See each product guide for the exact term, since it varies by category. Warranty claims require proof of purchase and photos of the defect.

## Product Guide: Tents
The Ridgeline 2P is our best-selling backpacking tent, weighing 3.2 lbs with a freestanding double-wall design rated for 3-season use. It sets up in under 5 minutes with color-coded poles.
The Basecamp 4P is a heavier, more spacious option for car camping, with a full-coverage rainfly. It is not recommended for backpacking due to its 8.5 lb weight.
Both tents include a 2-year manufacturer warranty covering material defects.

## Product Guide: Backpacks
The Traverse 55L is designed for multi-day backpacking trips, with an adjustable torso length, a ventilated back panel, and a rain cover included. Recommended load range is 30-45 lbs.
The Daytrekker 22L is a lighter option for single-day hikes, with a hydration bladder sleeve and hip belt pockets. It is not designed to carry loads over 20 lbs comfortably.
Both packs include a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects in stitching and zippers.
